version: V.01 passive spring hug, Mirumi proportions (one egg body, shoulder arms, diagonal groove)
official_FS90MG: datasheets/FS90MG.pdf p.5, edition A/0, 2021-04-30, all ±0.1 mm

servos.head_pan: FS90MG in yaw_collar, software ±42°, hard stop ±47°
servos.head_tilt: FS90MG on neck_turret, axis along x through y=6, z=119; software ±10°, first contact +16.5° (nod down) / -23.5° (look up)

hug.mechanism: Mirumi-style passive hug: each arm turns on a vertical M3 shoulder pin just under the face (knuckle z 70–86); a music-wire torsion spring in the knuckle closes it onto a printed rest stop (50° preload); opened by hand to a 30° printed stop; zero power to hold. Asymmetric arms: left over the chest, right under the belly

spring.part: music-wire torsion spring, 0.048 in (1.22 mm) wire, 3/8 in (9.5 mm) OD, 90° legs (trim to ~6 mm); catalogue 3HPG6 (LH) / 3HPD1 (RH)

hug.arm_angle_convention: 0 = closed on the rest stop, + = open; rotation about z through each shoulder (x=±44.6, y=−31.2)
hug.groove: R8 channel, off-centre and diagonal (35° from vertical, lower +x to upper −x), floor 7 mm below the skin at both arm crossings, 2.4 mm liner

grip.object: round Ø10.0 lying diagonally in the groove (35° from vertical)
round Ø12.5 lying diagonally in the groove (35° from vertical)
round Ø15.0 lying diagonally in the groove (35° from vertical)
flat strap 25 x 2.5 across the groove mouth, along the groove line

open.note: Ø15 x 50 rod slid in sideways across the groove (90 mm travel) at a stand-off above the floor, then dropped onto the floor, both arms on the 30° open stop; checked against both arms, both pads and torso_front.

hug.assumption: Spring rate from the catalogue (2.679 lbf·in at 90°), linear; no hinge friction; each arm clamps on its own (left over the chest at C_L, right under the belly at C_R); pad normal force = spring torque / |(r x n)_z| at the deepest pad contact. TPU pads assumed rigid for the angle (real pads add ~1 mm of squash). Not measured.

arm_min_clearance_mm.note: arm_to_shell 0 = the stop lug resting on its relief face (by design); knuckle to ear is 0.4 mm

proportions.shell_mm: Ø92 x 148 (one egg: R46 at z58, superellipse n=3.4 dome)
proportions.with_fur_mm: ≈106 wide (arm knuckles) x 104 deep x 152 tall

seated_on_bag.note: Mirumi pose: bottom resting on the bag top, both arms round the handle. The bag carries the weight; the springs hold it upright against the handle.

free_hang.note: Hanging free from the handle (nothing under it): the body rolls about the handle until the COM is under it, so with a vertical handle it hangs tipped about 35 deg sideways; slip along the handle is resisted only by friction.

clinging.assumption: Handle Ø12.5 lying on the diagonal groove floor line (35° from the body vertical). μ = 0.5 TPU/fur on a fabric or leather handle (ASSUMED). Pad forces from scripts/sim_v01.py. Not tested.

servo_power.note: Arms are passive and draw nothing; hugging costs no power. Budget the 5 V servo rail for ≥1.6 A peak.
